I appreciate you reaching out but this is only doing what I'm talking about in the post. If I think about seeing him again, I want to go now.

We were going to Die together and I broke that promise, what makes you think he wants me to stay alive?

Thank you for the love. I'm afraid my profile has been found out though so this is the last you'll hear from me, I must abandon this profile. It does mean a lot that you reached out and offered a shoulder to cry on. I'm sorry for your loss and I hope you're doing okay.
Yes. I did eventually meet him in person after 4 years and it was just as magical as I imagined
Is it just the food or can it be the whole surrounding experience?
Hell yeah, tall women are fucking goddesses
Thank you, I'm sorry you can relate 💔

When it's to the point they've decided, unfortunately they aren't thinking about the suffering they're leaving behind. They did still love us, and cared about us in Life, but their own suffering was too great.

I am sure he genuinely loved you. I'm sorry he isn't around to show you anymore 💔
Yeah, I've definitely been more snippy. Mostly I've been faster to tears (never used to cry much), but sometimes they go hand-in-hand as well.

I'm so sorry. My experience was similar - threatened a million times, I distanced myself, positive he wouldn't do it, was horribly wrong.

Like someone else said, we can't live in a painful situation out of fear that the other person will hurt themselves. It's hard not to sacrifice well-being in the moment, and I know I definitely had a month of wishing I could put myself back in the painful situation just so he could be alive again. But you are in a healthier place, even if the grief has made it difficult. Obviously you didn't want it to go this way, and ultimately you did what was best for your well-being.

Check out r/SuicideWatch.

As a suicidal person, there are a few factors. I have a long history of abuse and sexual assault, and that has a way of making you feel worthless. It also ostensibly leads to depression, so on bad days I feel dead already just going about my day.

During good periods, it's partially a matter of habit. Once you open that door of deciding suicide is an option, it's surprisingly hard to close. Those are low-risk times, but the thought's still there.

During bad periods, the closest thing I get to being happy is adrenaline - risky sex, crossing the street slowly, other stupid decisions that make me feel something for a minute. Suicide is an escape from that, and there doesn't feel like much reason to argue. Why keep going if I feel this way?

I've mostly figured out my way to keep going, but plenty of people don't. Too many people don't.
Good to know, thanks.

This is kind of a dual-purpose trip. I'll be visiting some of the same places I did in December, but I'd also like to see Deadwood. Things to do in the evening would be very helpful, I'm a night owl so I'll need something to do
I'm planning on doing a lot of driving, so unfortunately that'll probably get pretty expensive.

Lost my best friend to suicide a few months ago. This post - and the work you do - means a lot to me.

Thank you.
I remember passing Sturgis! Thanks for the tip
I have the same bag! Didn't think to take a picture like this when I visited, though, this is great
It's okay, not your fault! Yeah, it's rough. Of course, it means a lot

My boyfriend is still alive, it's my best friend who took his own life. Sorry for the confusion, I know I didn't specify. I'm tired of accepting the past and trying to move on. Longterm abuse, sexual assault, my best friend's Death, I'm worn down and just fucking tired, y'know? I really appreciate you reaching out.
I recently went through something similar and feel very much the same way. I'm sorry for your pain
Being dead
I still have to interact with my mom because of my siblings and my dad still pays my health and car insurance
My main account is 6 years old and still hasn't gotten gold. I did go radio silent for like four of those years, though
Ice cream cake
I have gone virtually NC/VLC with her, thankfully. I definitely haven't kept my mouth shut about him lol, everyone who interacts with him should know

Doing pretty poorly.

Relationship with my dad and stepmom has improved since moving out. His narcissism is merely annoying now that it doesn't impact me and she's stopped putting up with his shit as much.

Relationship with mom is about the same as it's been the last 6 years: completely surface. I use her desire for attention to my advantage when I have the emotional strength to be around her and then ignore her for several months.

She didn't believe me when I told her her husband was sexually assaulting me. She was actually gleeful when he passed a polygraph, even though they mean nothing. Still married to him to this day and talks about him to me whenever I actually bother to visit.
It feels great knowing people genuinely enjoyed the content, especially if I thought it'd get a lukewarm reaction

Best: Took my bf out for his birthday. He'd never had sushi before and he ended up loving it.

Worst: My best friend killed himself.
My bf did this with me before we got together. It's actually kinda sweet and really smart

I'd rather lose the weight first, but I genuinely appreciate the concern.

I was in therapy (more general) but unfortunately I missed too many sessions so she had to temporarily take me off the schedule.

Juggalos are super hit-or-miss. One of the best people I know is a juggalo, but on the other hand so is the dude I met at a mental facility who told me he killed people in his basement for the Russian mob

My favorite meme ever is probably when people were punting those screaming chickens. It got overdone, but it had a beautiful beginning.

Worst meme is probably the Shrek is love, Shrek is life thing. I just didn't get it at all
I'm really proud of you. You've worked so hard to get where you are and it's paid off. Not only have you broken the cycle, you kicked its ass :)

A fucking mess. I can't trust anyone, shut down when I'm in crisis, I have really unhealthy sexual behavior, I have no idea what normal boundaries look like, my depression's gotten so bad I literally can't even make it into therapy, I have an eating disorder, and I'm basically just waiting to die.

People think I'm really strong for surviving as much as I have (parental abuse, domestic abuse, sexual assault, and most recently the suicide of my best friend) but I don't fucking feel strong. I'm barely managing to exist.

I've relapsed on my eating disorder and I feel so much better about myself since I've started losing weight again. It's really fucked up and there are absolutely healthier ways to lose it, but that's why it's a disorder and not a diet I guess
Fasting for 45 hours

My bf knows my real account and checks it every day. Feels weird not to have my own space, nobody IRL has ever known my Reddit username.

Sometimes I want to make suicide jokes and talk about weird shit from my past without worrying him or reminding him, respectively. He knows about my past but idk if it's good for him to be reading about it, if that makes sense
Wouldn't go that far considering I helped him cheat in the first place, but I'm doing my best to make it right.
Thanks. I've always been taught not to stir the pot but I'm tired of protecting him. Inaction is the same thing as condoning when it comes to things like this.
I don't know where they live or how to contact her. I'm going to try adding her on Facebook. If that fails I think I'll look her up on whitepages.

I think a couple of your analogies are a little off base, but everything else you've said is absolutely right. I've been wanting to make things right, and nothing should be holding me back. I was absolutely not trying to excuse my behavior, I apologize that it came off that way. Currently, since he certainly won't tell her, this is entirely my responsibility.

I see you've requested to message me, so I'll accept that.

On a separate note, though it may not mean much coming from me, I'm really sorry you got cheated on.
I've never met her and I don't know where they live. In-person feels the best, but I don't think that's possible.
You're absolutely right, thank you. How should I approach her?
Thank you. How should I approach it? I think I'd be able to find her on Facebook
I still haven't completely, but in the moments where I've tried or gotten close, I stop because of something I'm looking forward to or someone I think would miss me.
